raw_shap_definition: Feature contributions to the raw Step-22B LightGBM spatial-anomaly output.
centered_shap_definition: Within-year raw SHAP contribution minus the same feature's mean raw SHAP contribution across all 2,194 grids in that year.
centered_shap_identity: sum(centered feature SHAP values) = Step-28 centered model-predicted spatial anomaly.
future_lst_identity: Step-28 final grid LST = forecast annual Kaduwela thermal level + centered spatial anomaly.
annual_level_explanation: Not attributed by SHAP. The citywide annual level is produced by the separate frozen annual forecasting branch.
global_importance_definition: Mean absolute centered SHAP contribution across all 10,970 2026-2030 future grid-year rows.
yearly_importance_definition: Mean absolute centered SHAP contribution across 2,194 grids within each future year.
interpretation: Positive centered SHAP pushes a grid hotter relative to Kaduwela's annual thermal level; negative centered SHAP pushes it cooler relative to that level.
causal_warning: SHAP explains the fitted model and forecast inputs. It does not prove causal environmental effects.
forecast_input_warning: 2026-2030 predictor values are forecasts rather than observed future measurements, so future SHAP explanations inherit forecast-input uncertainty.
evaluation_warning: Step 28B creates no new accuracy, validation, or test score.
